English / Japanese  

X Cubic

Write a program which calculates the cube of a given integer x.

Input

An integer x is given in a line.

Output

Print the cube of x in a line.

Constraints

  • 1 ≤ x ≤ 100

Sample Input 1

2

Sample Output 1

8

Sample Input 2

3

Sample Output 2

27
Source: https://onlinejudge.u-aizu.ac.jp/problems/ITP1_1_B
